s: dictionary (reference work with a list of words from one or more languages, and their definitions or translations)
Wörterbuch.et: From Wort (“word”) + -er- + Buch (“book”). Cognate with English wordbook, Dutch woordenboek, West Frisian wurdboek, Danish ordbog, Faroese orðabók, Icelandic orðabók, Norwegian Bokmål ordbok, Norwegian Nynorsk ordbok, Swedish ordbok and Volapük vödabuk.

s: Worms (an independent town in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany)
Worms.et: From Old High German Wormazia, Warmazia, etc., from Latin Vormatia, from a Gaulish name attested in Latin as Borbetomagus and Bormitomagus with influence from Latin -ātus (suffix forming adjectives) and suffix forming place names, of uncertain origin but usual…

s: Im Deutschen gibt es wenig Wörter, die mit y geschrieben werden.
In German there are few words spelt with y.
Er erklärte das Problem mit wenigen Worten.
He explained the problem in few words.
Keiner wagte dem Wort des Königs zu widersprechen.
No one dared contradict the king's word.
Er beherrscht unsere Sprache in Wort und Schrift.
He masters our language in speech and writing.
Der Präsident erteilte dem Abgeordneten das Wort.
The president gave the delegate the floor.
Ich gebe dir mein Wort, dass ich pünktlich da bin.
I give you my word that I shall be there on time.
the Word (epithet for Christ, the Second Person of the Trinity)
the Word of God, Scripture, the scriptures (collectively)
Wort.et: From Middle High German wort. Compare Dutch woord, English word, Danish ord. Doublet of Verb.

s: Wörthersee, Lake Wörth, an alpine lake in the southern Austrian province of Carinthia
lexicon (vocabulary of a language; vocabulary used by an individual)
Warum erfand Gott einen unnötigen Wortschatz, den nur, wie die Araber sagen, ein göttlicher Prophet in seinem ganzen Umfange fassen konnte?
Why did God invent an unnecessary vocabulary that only, as the Arabs say, a divine prophet could grasp in its entirety?
Wortschatz.et:
Wort (“word”) + Schatz (“treasure”).
Cognate with Dutch woordenschat, Afrikaans woordeskat and Luxembourgish Wuertschatz.
Attested since at least 1772 (see quote); possible calque of Dutch woordenschat.

worauf.et: Univerbation of wo + auf. By surface analysis, wo + -r- + auf.

worin.et: Middle High German worinne and newly formed Univerbation of wo inne, innen.

想找一条退路，说只要把一个人因果性的规定根据的方式（按照自然法则）套进一个比较的自由概念就行了——按照这个概念，人们有时把这样一种效果叫作自由的：规定它的自然根据在起作用的存在者内部；例如一个被抛出的物体在自由运动时所做的事，人们用「自由」这个词，是因为它在飞行时不受外部任何东西推动；或者像我们把钟表的运动也叫作自由运动，因为它自己推动指针，指针因此不需要从外面去拨；同样，人的行动虽然因时间上在先的规定根据而是必然的，人们却仍称之为自由的，因为它们毕竟是由我们自己的力量产生的内在表象、由此按诱发的情境产生的欲望、因而是按我们自己的意愿造成的行动——这是一个可怜的遁词。有些人至今还用它来搪塞自己，以为用一点咬文嚼字就解决了那个艰难的问题；几千年来人们一直在徒劳地解决这个问题，所以它的答案恐怕很难就这么浮在表面上被找到。
